recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future complex Timing scheduling ambiguity should be handled as a new work-group decision rather than by changing FHIR-12352.
issue_request: FHIR-12352 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 and requested support for MedicationOrder dosage schedules at specific times of day by adding Timing.repeat.timeOfDay 0..* time with definition "Specified time of day for action to take place."
initial_application: SVN r10350, mirrored as git commit 91bf3e7b836dc9486da4c4d4b7829d9df7167900, explicitly applied FHIR-12352 together with FHIR-10478 and FHIR-12201 by adding dayOfWeek/timeOfDay support to source/datatypes/timing.xml. Current source still contains Timing.repeat.timeOfDay 0..* time with the requested definition, and source/fhir.ini keeps Timing in the active datatype build and normative list.
additional_context: Later Published decisions refined the original restriction language: FHIR-12460 loosened Timing invariants so timeOfDay/dayOfWeek can coexist with frequency and period, FHIR-23710 approved timeOfDay being exclusive only with when, and the already-published combined-branch FHIR-25289 commit 542e45405a17e048b338101140592af45aae9dcd clarified that timeOfDay occurs at specified times as otherwise constrained by repeat timing. FHIR-12709 fixed the original typo, and FHIR-36940 was retracted/no-change.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already defines the requested element and aligns with later final decisions, while restoring the original frequency/period prohibition would be incorrect.
